newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Profit-taking hits bullish SIMEX Nikkei futures.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking hits bullish SIMEX Nikkei futures.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended a shade weaker on Wednesday but dealers said the overall trend was still firm.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract closed down 25 points at 21,470. Volume was a relatively low 14,315 lots.

The market rose sharply on Tuesday in line with a new record high on Wall Street and following reports that the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) was set to win a clear victory in the Japanese general election on October 20.
"Sentiment is bullish on the Japanese markets...they are hoping for a clear result," said one dealer in Singapore.
A chartist said the December contract's close above 21,460 again on Wednesday was positive for the market. It gave the contract a new target of 21,555, he said.
"If it can take out 21,555, then we will see more upside," he said. "The critical level to watch for will be 21,760. A close above that would be beautiful."
